items.summary: Application IntegrationFeatureApplication Integration agent skillsApplication Integration agent skills are available in the publicgoogle/skills repository:application-integration-basics, application-integration-authoring, andapplication-integration-troubleshooting. AI coding agents that use theseskills can help you set up Application Integration; build, publish, and runintegrations through the REST API; and troubleshoot failed runs. For moreinformation, seeApplication Integration agent skillsand Build an integration with an AI agent.BigtableFeatureYou can configure Bigtable tables with microsecond timestamp granularity tocapture and store high-frequency data. By supporting microsecond precision forcell timestamps, Bigtable helps you prevent data loss from write collisions inworkloads with high event rates. This feature isgenerally available (GA)for instances in the Enterprise Plus edition. For more information, seeData type enforcement in Bigtable.
